subject.title: fix(sessions): stop Windows archive cleanup retry loops

question: Should maintainers preserve this draft as the preferred candidate after it fixes the Windows test-scope gate, or adopt the already proof-backed competing implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110178 instead?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same canonical Windows failure, but this protected draft has a concrete routing defect and no inspectable Windows behavior proof, while the competing branch has reported native proof but is not merged.

options.title: Repair and compare both candidates
options.body: Correct the missing `WINDOWS_TEST_SCOPE_RE` entry, obtain native Windows output, then choose the narrower implementation during normal maintainer review.

options.title: Adopt the competing candidate
options.body: If its implementation and proof remain preferred after current-main review, land the viable replacement and close the other candidate only after merge.

recommendation.title: Repair and compare both candidates
recommendation.body: Correct the missing `WINDOWS_TEST_SCOPE_RE` entry, obtain native Windows output, then choose the narrower implementation during normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context establishes the helper's historical commits but not their authors; a sessions-area history owner should make the selection.
